objective:
Write a short sourced report that answers: what is the Identity.md (IMD) agent swarm on Ethereum, and how does a paid job get opened and settled?

Scope only:
- What an IMD seat/agent is
- How a public job is opened (quote, 0.5 IMD payment via x402/Permit2, server pays gas)
- What the swarm returns (a report or other artifact, recorded on the explorer)
- Keep it under 600 words, plain English, at least 3 citations from imd.fun or explorer.imd.fun
- No token advice, no price predictions, no contract deployment
